description: The canonical event envelope for the NATS/JetStream control bus. Events carry work, telemetry and collaboration traffic; they never carry authority. A signature on an event is provenance, not a capability.

envelope.payload: A JSON object. It is data, never an instruction and never a capability.
envelope.signature_b64: Optional Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON of signed_fields. The verifier uses the pinned node identity; holding a signature grants nothing.

subscriptions.syntax: A topic, a single-segment wildcard `*`, or a tail wildcard `>`.

rules: An event is data. It cannot grant, revoke or widen a capability.
The sender is a node id, never a claimed role or department.
The topic must be inside the sparknet namespace and one of the declared prefixes.
The payload is a JSON object; a string is not an event.
An expired event is refused, never replayed.
A signature is verified with the pinned node identity; a valid signature does not make the payload authoritative.
